regular.name: Regular Cleaning
regular.description: Keep your home fresh, tidy, and sparkling every week. The effortless way to maintain a clean, healthy space.
features: Thoroughly sanitized kitchen & bathrooms
Vacuumed carpets & freshly mopped hard floors
Dust-free furniture, counters & surfaces
Gleaming countertops, faucets & sinks
Trash removal & tidy up throughout

deep.name: Deep Cleaning (GoFurther)
deep.description: A comprehensive refresh when your home needs extra care. We reach the hidden grime, baseboards, and forgotten corners.
features: Everything included in Regular Cleaning
Hand-wiping of baseboards, door frames & trim
Deep scrubbing of tile grout & bathroom buildup
Exterior cabinet fronts degreased & polished
Intensive sanitization for high-touch areas

moveInOut.name: Move-In / Move-Out
moveInOut.description: Move with total peace of mind. We make your new home move-in ready or your previous place spotless for deposit return.
features: Everything included in Deep Cleaning
Inside empty closets, drawers & built-in shelving
Window sills, tracks & interior glass wiped down
Disinfected baseboards, switches & doors
Guaranteed ready for landlord or buyer walkthrough

postConstruction.name: Post-Construction
postConstruction.description: Turn your newly remodeled space into a clean, safe, and livable home. We eliminate fine drywall dust so you can move right in.
features: Specialized capture of fine dust, plaster & drywall powder
Removal of paint specks, tape & sticker residue
Detailed dusting of light fixtures, vents & ledges
Floors and tiles stripped of construction residue
Fresh, breathable air ready for you to enjoy

pricing.minNotice: $99 minimum service fee per visit. Final price is calculated using verified dimensions and selected extras.

about.title: Caring for Your Home as if It Were Our Own
about.subtitle: Denver's trusted property care team dedicated to healthy spaces, reliable cleaners, and upfront pricing.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We believe a clean, orderly home gives you back valuable time, better health, and true peace of mind. We combine hospital-grade standards with genuine hospitality to deliver sparkling spaces for families and businesses across Denver and Boulder.

values.ecoDesc: We strictly use non-toxic, biodegradable cleaning agents that protect your indoor air quality and loved ones.
values.vettedDesc: Every cleaner is thoroughly vetted, trained in modern techniques, and covered by comprehensive liability insurance.
values.standardDesc: We follow a meticulous checklist to ensure zero missed spots, from high ceiling corners to clean floorboards.
values.pricingDesc: No unpredictable hourly estimates. You pay for the exact size of your space with guaranteed transparency.

checklist.title: Our Signature Cleaning Checklist
checklist.subtitle: A room-by-room procedure designed to leave every space immaculate.
checklist.kitchen: Countertops, stovetop, exterior appliances, gleaming sink & sanitized cabinet fronts.
checklist.bathrooms: Tile scrubbed, glass polished, toilets & showers disinfected, streak-free mirrors.
checklist.living: High/low dusting, mirrors, picture frames, and vacuuming under accessible furniture.
checklist.floors: Thorough carpet vacuuming and damp-mopping of hard floors with gentle, fresh-scented cleaners.

cta.title: Ready to Experience Impeccable Property Care?
cta.subtitle: Book your service online in minutes. Enjoy transparent $/sq ft rates and zero surprise travel fees in Denver & Boulder core.

pets_presence.name: Home with Pets
pets_presence.description: Special attention to remove stubborn pet hair and freshen up upholstery and floors.

high_ceilings.name: High Ceilings or Tall Windows
high_ceilings.description: Safe, thorough dusting of high fixtures, chandeliers, and hard-to-reach windows.

oven_fridge_interior.name: Oven & Fridge Interior
oven_fridge_interior.description: Deep interior wipe-down and degreasing, clean and ready for your fresh groceries.

cabinets_interior.name: Inside Cabinets & Drawers
cabinets_interior.description: Internal cleaning and sanitizing of kitchen or bathroom cabinets and pantry shelves.

basement_attic.name: Finished Basement or Attic
basement_attic.description: Include complete cleaning for your finished lower-level suite or usable attic space.

patio_balcony.name: Outdoor Balcony or Patio
patio_balcony.description: Sweeping and washing of your private patio or balcony so you can enjoy the fresh air.
